title: 'Kyokou Suiri' Author to Launch 'Vampire Juujikai' Sequel in October 2026
content:
The official X account of Square Enix's Monthly Shounen Gangan announced on Friday that Kyokou Suiri ( In/Spectre ) author Kyou Shirodaira will launch a sequel manga of Vampire Juujikai , titled Vampire Juujikai: Inu ni wa Inu no Uta ( Vampire Cross World: A Song for Dogs ) featuring illustrations by Yuri Kimura in the November issue on October 9.

Shiradora began serializing Vampire Juujikai ( The Record of a Fallen Vampire ) on Shonen Gangan magazine with illustrations by Kimura from August 2003 to February 2007. Square Enix published the first volume in December 2003. The ninth and final volume was published in April 2007.

Viz Media and Yen Press licensed the manga in English. They released the ninth and final volume in May 2010 and December 2014, respectively.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Fourth Opening Featuring "88" by LM.C
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its fourth opening, featuring the song “88” by LM.C. The song was used in Episodes 74-101, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the special Episode 62 ending featuring “friend” performed by Kyoko’s and Haru’s voice actresses, Yuna Inamura and Hitomi Yoshida. The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series Mousetrap Rises to No. 1 on Global Non-English Series on Netflix
content:
The webtoon-based live-action series Mousetrap has topped Netflix 's global Top 10 chart for non-English TV shows for the week of August 31 through September 6.

According to Netflix 's rankings released on September 8, Mousetrap reached No. 1 in its second week after debuting at No. 5 in its first week.

The series, which is based on the webtoon Field Mouse , recorded 4.4 million views and appeared in the Top 10 in 45 countries, including South Korea, Malaysia, Oman, the Philippines, Argentina, Mexico, Hungary, Egypt, and Nigeria.

The series follows reclusive novelist Moon-jae, whose life is upended by a mysterious figure known only as "Field Mouse." In a desperate attempt to reclaim what he's lost, Moon-jae teams up with No-ja, a ruthless loan shark who once pursued him.

Hong-sun Kim directs the series, with Jun-yeol Ryu starring as Moon-jae, Kyung-gu Sul as loan shark Noja, and Kyoo-hyung Lee as detective Sun-yong.

Field Mouse was originally serialized from 2017-2020 by webtoon artist Ludovico. Its story is inspired by the Korean folktale "The Rat That Ate Fingernails," which tells the story of a rat that transforms into a human after consuming someone's fingernails.

An English version of the webtoon is not currently available.
author: ANN

title: Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes Fighting Game Releases DLC Character Zohar The 'Doppelganger' on September 15
content:
Arc System Works announced on Friday that it will release the new DLC character Zohar The "Doppelganger" for Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes , the newest installment in French Bread's original Under Night In-Birth 2D fighting game series, on September 15 for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam . The character will launch for Nintendo Switch on September 23.

Aiko Ōkubo is voicing Zohar The "Doppelganger." Arc System Works describes the character:

She was one of the leaders of Bankikai, along with Ogre and Strix. During the battle with Amnesia, she was engulfed by the power overflowing from the Abyss. She lost her sanity, leaving her close friend Strix heavily wounded. She was at a loss, burdened by what she had done to her friend. In her despair, she heard rumors that Strix was still alive. She had changed her name and entered the Night, searching for "her." "I must find her…" "I must apologize to her…" "I must kill her…" The disparate thoughts raced through her head. Were they Zohar's own feelings, or did they belong to the “other” her? The answer she sought lurked within the Night.

Arc System Works released the game on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam in January 2024. The game's season pass includes Uzuki, which released in July 2024, as well as an early unlock code for Kuon. Ogre joined the game in February 2025 as part of the season pass. Izumi (voiced by Reina Kondo ) joined the game in August 2025.

ucio performs the theme song "Rinne no Owari e" (Toward the End of Reincarnation).

The game features the final chapter in the "Hollow Night" storyline that began with the original series. There were 21 returning characters as well as three new characters at launch. The new characters are Kaguya, Tsurugi, and Kuon.

French Bread ( Melty Blood ) developed the original Under Night In-Birth game, which launched in Japan as an arcade game in 2012. It was followed by an updated arcade game titled Under Night In-Birth Exe:Late in 2013. Arc System Works released a PS3 port of Under Night In-Birth Exe:Late in Japan in 2014. Aksys Games released the game for PS3 in North America in February 2015. The original Under Night In-Birth was never released outside of arcades.

The follow-up version is titled Under Night In-Birth Exe:Late[st] . The arcade version of the game launched in July 2015 in Japan, and Arc System Works released the game on the PS3 and PS4 in Japan in July 2017. Aksys Games released the game for the PS4 and PS Vita in North America in February 2018, and PQube Games released the game on the same platforms in Europe on the same date. Arc System Works released the game on PC via Steam in August 2018. The follow-up to that version was Under Night In-Birth EXE:Late[cl-r] . The game debuted on PS4 and Switch in Feburary 2020, and debuted on PC via Steam in March 2020.

The Under Night In-Birth game series is notable for its unique GRD mechanic. Aside from life and super move gauge, players fight over a secondary resource known as GRD, which can be gained or lost from the results of certain offensive and defensive exchanges. Every 16 seconds, the player with the most GRD is awarded a buff that increases their damage, and access to a cancel that also converts their existing GRD to an amount in the super gauge. In this way, players are just as often fighting for a lead on the GRD in addition to the life lead.

French Bread developed the Melty Blood: Type Lumina 2D fighting game, based on characters from Type-Moon 's Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon- remake visual novel. The game launched for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in September 2021. A new version of the game titled Melty Blood : Twi-Lumina will debut in early 2027 for the PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PC via Steam .

title: Voice Actor Kentarō Itō Goes on Hiatus Following Brain Hemorrhage, Surgery
content:
The agency stated that a few days ago Itō suddenly started feeling unwell, and was transported to the hospital, where he had symptoms of a brain hemorrhage, and underwent emergency surgery that same day. Mausu Promotion said his life is not in danger, and his postoperative progress is going well. However, for the time being he will focus on rehabilitation treatment with the goal of being able to return to work.

The agency stated it will make an announcement again when Itō's return has been decided.

Itō is a prolific voice actor who has also been involved in stage productions and dubbing Western animated series, in addition to voicing roles in anime and video games.

Some of his major roles include Renji Abarai in Bleach , Yoshitake Shiraishi in Golden Kamuy , Han Ki (Huan Yi) in Kingdom , Chouji Akimichi in Naruto , Jin Tadoroko in Yowamushi Pedal , Gōki Daimonji in Cardfight!! Vanguard , and Kazuichi Banjō in Tokyo Ghoul .

He is currently voicing Renji in the ongoing Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity anime.

title: Aizen Is Back in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 48 Preview
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 8 (Episode 48 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes.

The fifth episode is titled “THE END TWO WORLD,” and it will premiere on Saturday, September 12. You can see the synopsis and preview images below.

Uryu slammed the central island of Wahrwelt, which possessed an enormous amount of energy, into the “Distortion,” successfully causing their mutual annihilation. However, for Yhwach, who had reclaimed all of the Schrifts and elevated the power of “The Almighty,” the Distortion was no longer necessary. Declaring that he would destroy the Seireitei as one final amusement, Yhwach vanished. With his Bankai shattered and his Zanpakuto broken, Ichigo had sunk into the depths of despair, unable even to stand. The flame of his courage was on the verge of fading. Then, before him appeared men with whom he had once crossed swords…

ALSO READ: Interview: Ichigo Voice Actors Masakazu Morita and Johnny Yong Bosch Talk BLEACH BLEACH JET Artbook and Ryogo Narita’s School Life Novel Return, Fan Vote and 2027 Exhibition Announced

BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 48 Staff:

• Script: Masaki Hiramatsu

• Storyboard: Shinichiro Ueda

• Episode Director: Shinichiro Ueda

• Chief Animation Director: Kiyomi Komatsubara

• Animation Directors: Manamu Amasaki (爆画大阪スタジオ), Natsuko Suzuki, Izumi Kondo, Kazuo Takigawa, Mika Okubo

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.
author: Anime Corner

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Part 2 Trailer and October 13 Premiere Revealed, Sora Amamiya Joins Cast
content:
Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle revealed a new trailer for its Cour 2, along with the theme songs and an October 13, 2026 premiere. Sora Amamiya is joining the cast as Mai Todo. The first cour concluded in March. Studio feel. is in charge of the animation.

The second cour’s theme songs are:

• “Saku” by Cidergirl

• “Doko ni mo Ikenai Mama” by aruma

Both can be heard in the new trailer.

The main voice cast for the anime includes:

• Shogo Sakata as Saku Chitose

• Manaka Iwami as Yuko Hiiragi

• Hina Youmiya as Yua Uchida

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Yuzuki Nanase

• Rumi Okubo as Haru Aomi

• Chika Anzai as Asuka Nishino

You can see the main characters in the previously revealed visual below.

The following staff is credited for the Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle anime:

• Original Work: Hiromu

• Original Character Design: raemz

• Director: Yuji Tokuno

• Series Structure: Naruhisa Arakawa

• Script: Hiromu, Naruhisa Arakawa

• Character Design: Sumie Kinoshita

• Animation Production: feel.

The anime is adapting a light novel series written by Hiromu and illustrated by raemz. Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle has been serialized by Shogakukan’s Gagaga Bunko imprint since June 2019. A manga adaptation by Bobcat began in Square Enix’s Manga Up! in April 2020.

Yen Press licensed the light novel l in English, describing the story: Being popular isn’t easy. It’s hard to beat Saku Chitose. The most popular kid in his high school? Check. An ironclad reputation that can weather even vicious online attacks? Check. A group of friends as attractive on the outside as they are inside? Check. But when a teacher asks for his help bringing back a student who has been shut away in his room for months, Saku’s perfect world will never be the same. What is this, some kind of normie harem story…?
author: Anime Corner

title: Shakugan no Shana: Blaze Edge Browser Game Launches on September 14
content:
The game is free-to-play with in-app purchases, and will be available in Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, and Korean.

Viz Media describes the light novel series' story:

Invaders from the Crimson Realm have come to Earth looking for something called the Power of Existence. Whoever possesses this profound power will control the very quintessence of reality. To the rescue comes an enigmatic young girl with fire blazing in her eyes. She may be cute and petite, but she's endowed with enough preternatural strength to save the entire universe. Plus, she's got a really big sword!

Rie Kugimiya voices the character of Shana.

Takahashi launched the light novel series in 2002 with illustrations by The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya illustrator Noizi Itō . Takahashi published the 22nd and last of the main novels in 2011, the Shakugan no Shana SIII short story collection book in 2012, and the final fan guidebook in 2013. Viz published two novels for the series in 2007.

Shakugan no Shana SIV launched in November 2023 as the first new volume in the franchise since Shakugan no Shana SIII in 2012. Dengeki Bunko editor and producer Kazuma Miki confirmed the new volume was the fourth Shakugan no Shana S short story collection. Previously, Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko Magazine published a new story for the franchise , its first in four years, in August 2017.

The novels inspired three television anime series. The first series premiered in 2005. Shakugan no Shana Second , the second series, premiered in 2007. The Shakugan no Shana III (Final) anime series aired in 2011 and adapted the novel series' ending.

title: 'Toaru Anbu no Item' Announces Additional Staff
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kazuma Kamachi 's Toaru Anbu no Item ( A Certain Dark Side's Item ) light novel revealed additional staff and a key visual (pictured) on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 9 at 10.30 p.m. on AT-X, followed by Tokyo MX and BS11 on October 10.

Staff Series Composition: Shougo Yasukawa ( Shokugeki no Souma ) Animation Character Design Corporation: Kiyotaka Haimura ( Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka ), Nilitsu ( Tsuyokute New Saga ), Motoi Fuyukawa , strelka Art Director: Teruhiko Niita ( Otaku ni Yasashii Gal wa Inai!? ) Color Design: Tomomi Andou ( Boushoku no Berserk ) Director of Photography: Shingo Fukuyo ( Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka ) Editing: Shigeru Nishiyama ( Bungou Stray Dogs ) Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa ( Takopii no Genzai ) Music: Maiko Iuchi ( Akudama Drive )

Tatsuyuki Nagai ( Toaru Kagaku no Railgun ) is directing the anime at J.C.Staff . Shigeki Kimoto ( Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka ) ia designing the characters.

All-girl rock band East Of Eden is performing the opening theme "Ghost Sequence." Rock band Kisida Kyodan & The Akebosi Rockets ( Toaru Kagaku no Railgun T ) is performing the ending theme "Meltdowner."

title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared Season 2 Reveals New Trailer, Cast and September 26 Streaming Premiere
content:
A Wild Last Boss Appeared has revealed its second Season 2 trailer, confirming that the anime will have a streaming premiere on September 26 a week ahead of its regular TV broadcast starting in October 2026. The sequel was announced immediately after the first season’s finale.

The anime previously revealed new cast and opening theme song “Melodic Impact” by Japanese rock band Suspended 4th. Today more additions were revealed:

• Akio Otsuka as Leon

• Atsushi Miyauchi as Sagittarius

• Shuhei Sakaguchi as Mercurius

The second trailer previews the ending theme “Yurete Skirt” by four-member girls rock band Chakura. Check it out below.

Including the director Yuya ‌Horiuchi, the main staff for the A Wild Last Boss Appeared anime consists of the following members:

• Director: Yuya Horiuchi

• Series Composition: Kazuyuki Fudeyasu

• Original Character Design: Yahako

• Character Design: Maiko Ebisawa

• Sub Character Design: Takashi Kobayashi, Shota Ueno

• Producer: WOWMAX

• Animation Studio: WAO World

Firehead writes the A Wild Last Boss Appeared (Yasei no Rasu Bosu ga Arawareta) light novel series, which features illustrations by YahaKo. It first began on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in October 2015, with Earth Star Entertainment publishing a print edition under their Earth Star Novel imprint from February 2016. Both ended on April 15, 2019. There is also a manga adaptation by Tsubasa Hazuki, which began serialization on Earth Star Entertainment’s Comic Earth Star website in June 2017 and is currently ongoing. J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga in English. The franchise has surpassed 1.7 million copies in circulation.

The story follows a man who wakes up in the body of his MMO character, Lufas Maphaahl, the feared Black-Winged Tyrant and leader of the Twelve Heavenly Stars, 200 years after her defeat in a player-driven event of the game Exgate Online . But this is no longer a game, but rather it’s reality. With her reign long past and her name remembered only in fear, Lufas now navigates a different world, looking for answers, allies, and a way to confront the chaos and monsters that her “death” left behind.
